prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — baggage (n.行李): Two travel suitcases, a duffel and a small handbag grouped at a station platform, luggage collection clearly visible.
TOP RIGHT — desert (v.(军队中)开小差): A uniformed soldier quietly leaves a military camp behind at night carrying a small bag, looking back; desertion, no sandy desert.
BOTTOM LEFT — unrealistic (a.不真实的): A person imagines an impossible tiny balloon lifting a huge stone, thought bubble contrasted with the grounded stone below.
BOTTOM RIGHT — paradise (n.天堂，乐土): A peaceful tropical island with white beach, palm trees, clear blue water and a relaxed traveler in shade; idyllic earthly haven.
review_notes: Reviewed luggage grouping and soldier deserting camp rather than sandy desert. Bottom thought-bubble and paradise palm extend too near midpoint; both superseded by academy-b3-repair-033-01 for crop-safe redraw.
